prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In after Pet Adoption: Defer account sign-in until after the pet is selected and customized, letting users build emotional attachment before signing in. (why: Sign-in early creates unnecessary friction; 8 support emails noted account sign-in confusion regarding existing pets.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Fast-Track Adoption Flow: Add an instant adoption pathway with ready-to-use pets to skip photo uploads for users wanting immediate desktop companionship. (why: Custom pet generation fails or takes too long for some users (3 support tickets, 1017s mean adoption time).)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-in Data Protection Hint: Add a prominent explanatory hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves and syncs pet profiles. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Status Diagnostics: Display live system check steps and overlay permission verification while waiting for the pet to spawn on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not displaying on desktop; waiting screen median time is 201s.)
4: [finish, layout] Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome: Switch home_intro layout to spotlight mode to emphasize the single action needed to launch the desktop pet. (why: Finish step drop-off is high (64.8% conversion, mean 5815s); a focused final action reduces drop-outs.)
5: [home, notification] Background Rendering Notification Prompt: Allow users to opt into desktop system notifications while waiting for pet rendering to complete in the background. (why: The waiting step takes a mean of 2336s; desktop notifications let users return to work without abandoning setup.)

scores.note: Addresses sign-in drop-off and 8 support emails by deferring friction, but requires architectural flow changes.
Adoption has a 39.1% drop-off and 1017s mean time; fast-track bypasses generation issues but requires new screens.
Low-cost copy addition resolving pet reset confusion noted in 8 support emails.
Helps users understand rendering status during the 201s median wait time at the home step.
Finish step has a large 35.2% drop-off; spotlighting the launch action guides users to completion.
Tackles long mean waiting time (2336s) by allowing users to leave and return via system notification.
